body.purpose: Supporting copy, journal titles, and CTA labels in Inter roman.

label.purpose: SCROLL, stats captions, and journal meta in 12px Inter.

shadows.purpose: Ambient drop under rotated exploration images.

shadows.name: load-bar-glow
shadows.purpose: Steel bloom on the loading progress fill.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bone-filled pill CTA with a steel hover ring; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-text)); color: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms, background-color 300ms, color 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Ink pill with a 2px hairline; steel ring replaces the border on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-ghost::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover::before, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Compact hairline pill for section actions such as View all work.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-outline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-outline:hover::before, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Email Pill
components.description: Frosted charcoal contact pill used in the footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-email { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); outline: none; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-email::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-email:hover, .ds-btn-email:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-email:hover::before, .ds-btn-email:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Floating Pill Nav
components.description: Top-center frosted pill with TL mark, sentence-case links, and Say hi.
components.html: Say hi ↗
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-mark { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-mark-core { position: absolute; inset: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Instrument Serif, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-nav-mark:hover .ds-nav-mark-core, .ds-nav-mark:focus-visible .ds-nav-mark-core { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-nav-rule { width: 1px; height: 20px; margin: 0 4px; background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); } .ds-nav-link { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke) / 0.5); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke) / 0.5); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-nav-hi { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-hi:hover, .ds-nav-hi:focus-visible { color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); }

components.name: Bento Project Card
components.description: 24px photograph tile with italic serif title and a View pill overlay.
components.css: .ds-bento { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 24px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-bento-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2a3340, #12151a); } .ds-bento-title { position: absolute; left: 20px; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Instrument Serif, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-style: italic; } .ds-bento-view { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: hsl(var(--lp-bg) / 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); color: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 500ms; } .ds-bento-view em { font-family: Instrument Serif, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; } .ds-bento-view::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: min(70%, 220px); height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; z-index: -1; } .ds-bento:hover .ds-bento-view, .ds-bento:focus-visible .ds-bento-view { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Journal Row
components.description: Pill row with circular thumbnail, title, and tracked meta.
components.html:
The quiet power of negative space

4 minMar 12, 2026
components.css: .ds-journal { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface) / 0.3); transition: background-color 300ms; } .ds-journal:hover { background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); } .ds-journal-thumb { width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #3a4450, #1a1d22); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-journal-title { flex: 1; margin: 0; min-width: 12rem; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-journal-meta { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Exploration Tile
components.description: Rotated 16px square study with a dark ambient drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-explore { width: 200px; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #4a5564, #1c2026); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); transform: rotate(-6deg); cursor: pointer; } .ds-explore:hover, .ds-explore:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lp-grad-from); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: TL Mark
components.description: Italic serif TL on an ink disc inside a steel gradient halo.
components.css: .ds-tl { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from) 0%, var(--lp-grad-to) 100%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tl-core { position: absolute; inset: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: Instrument Serif, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 0.025em; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-tl:hover, .ds-tl:focus-visible { background-image: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--lp-grad-from) 0%, var(--lp-grad-to) 100%); } .ds-tl:hover .ds-tl-core, .ds-tl:focus-visible .ds-tl-core { transform: scale(1.1); }

narrative.overview:
Talaria-Log’s marketing surface is a dark editorial portfolio, not a SaaS feature grid and not the Hero UI chart shell. The visitor arrives through a 000–100 load on near-black, meets the italic serif name over muted full-bleed video, and scrolls selected work, journal, and explorations before a reprise of that atmosphere in the footer. Chrome is floating, pill-shaped, and hairline-framed; the only chromatic voice is a steel-blue gradient used as a halo, never as a filled marketing slab.

This file is the landing visual world. Product chrome stays on Hero UI tokens and components recorded in docs/DESIGN.md. The two systems do not share a type pairing, a radius language, or a color format. The product name on this door is Talaria-Log. Inter (body, headlines, UI) and italic Instrument Serif (display) are user-pinned for this marketing surface and are not to be swapped for a “more original” pairing.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black HSL field (`--lp-*`) with bone type and fog secondary
Steel-blue accent gradient as hover rings, TL mark halo, and load bar only
Floating top-center pill nav with italic TL monogram
Hairline strokes and frosted charcoal glass
Rounded-full chrome; 24px bento cards; 16px exploration tiles
Instrument Serif italic for the name, accent words, project titles, stats, and marquee

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Landing color lives in `--lp-*` HSL channels scoped to `.landing-page`. App chrome keeps Hero UI OKLCH tokens in `docs/DESIGN.md`. Do not paint marketing with `--background` / `--accent`, and do not paint the chart shell with `--lp-*`.

rules.name: The Steel Line Rule
rules.body: The steel gradient is chrome, not fill. It may outline a pill, halo the TL mark, or draw the 3px load bar. It may not fill a hero slab, a card, or a section background.

rules.name: The Pinned Pair Rule
rules.body: Inter + Instrument Serif are user-pinned on this marketing surface. Do not replace them with a display face, a geometric sans, or the Hero UI product font.

rules.name: The Italic Word Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is italic for names, accent words, project titles, stats, and the marquee. Body paragraphs stay Inter roman. The 000–100 counter is serif roman tabular-nums, not italic.

rules.name: The Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Default depth is video, scrim, and hairline — not offset card shadows. A drop shadow is a response (scrolled nav) or a gallery-tile exception, never a card rest state for work or journal.

rules.name: The Pill Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome is `rounded-full`. Photographs sit in 16–24px rounded rectangles. Do not square off buttons, nav, or the TL mark.

dos: Do scope landing styles to `.landing-page` / `.landing-overlay` and the `--lp-*` tokens.
Do set display type in Instrument Serif italic, and keep body, headlines, and UI in Inter.
Do use the steel gradient only as a 2px hover ring, TL halo, or load bar.
Do keep chrome `rounded-full` and hit targets at least 44px.
Do cap reading copy around `max-w-md` and the page column at 1200px.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion` on load, role cycle, gradient shift, and marquee.
donts: Don't mix this world with Hero UI components or OKLCH product tokens on the marketing page.
Don't fill a section, card, or hero with the steel gradient.
Don't set body paragraphs in Instrument Serif, or swap the pinned pairing.
Don't square off nav, buttons, or the TL mark.
Don't load the full dataset, a chart engine, or app chrome into this door — it is a portfolio arrival, not the trading shell.
Don't add a second chromatic accent. Bone, fog, and steel are the voice.
